page.overview:
Who is Falion Bhoda?

Falion Bhoda was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, who was also Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters and became a Dreadlord of the Shadow before the Last Battle.

Falion was a cold, long-faced Kandori with dark, glossy hair. She stands 5'5 tall.

She was willing to use the Power to torture anyone, even to death, but was dispassionate about it. She only cared whether they gave her the answers she wanted.

Falion was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . While she is strong enough to be able to Travel, it's not certain she would have had the opporunity to learn from any Black Sister we know can Travel.
